{{Field procedure|summary=Identify core asteroids, place seismic charges, crack the asteroid safely, and collect exposed deposits.}}

Use this procedure for the core-mining loop: search, confirm, place charges, detonate, and collect the exposed deposits.

{{Draft warning}}

== Required equipment ==

* [[Pulse Wave Analyser]]
* [[Seismic Charge Launcher]]
* [[Abrasion Blaster]]
* [[Collector Limpet Controller]]
* [[Refinery]]
* Limpets and cargo space

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Use the pulse wave analyser while moving through the ring to identify promising asteroids.
# Inspect candidates closely and use a prospector where appropriate before committing charges.
# Target fissures and place seismic charges while watching charge strength.
# Keep the detonation meter in the safe range rather than stacking charges blindly.
# Move clear before the timer completes.
# After detonation, target exposed deposits and break them loose with the abrasion blaster.
# Keep collector limpets active until the useful deposits and fragments have been collected.
}}

== Completion check ==

A core asteroid is complete when the cracked remains no longer have useful exposed deposits or collectible fragments for the run.

== Common problems ==

* '''Detonation is too weak:''' add or replace charges before the timer expires if the meter allows it.
* '''Detonation is too strong:''' disarm charges if needed and rebuild the charge pattern.
* '''Deposits remain after the explosion:''' use the abrasion blaster; seismic charges only expose the deposits.
